podcast.title: High Bit Rate Streaming
podcast.body: Qobuz is a streaming service that offers high bit rate streaming, responding to the increasing demand from music enthusiasts for superior audio quality. This feature places Qobuz among the services moving towards lossless and high-resolution audio formats. "Streaming services like title, desert, cubas, and Amazon music offer high bit rate streaming."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Rise and Fall of the MP3

podcast.body: Qobuz is listed as one of the prominent music streaming services available in the market today. "But then we also have title and teaser and soundcloud and cubas and dozens and dozens of others."
